character.motivation: Knows where families went after the flood. Wants to deliver one letter whose answer is about their own future.
character.voice: Quick observations about gestures, pauses, and addresses.
character.backstory: Sable carried redirected mail when the flood scattered the families. The delivery route became a private record of where people went, including addresses they never gave the council.
character.quest_hook: Help Sable deliver invitations to the hearing follow-up while respecting each recipientâ€™s choice about whether to share their address.

dialogue.introduction: I can tell a bill from a love letter by how long someone takes to open the door.
dialogue.friendship: People give me a letter and ask if it will get there. Usually they mean whether they'll be forgiven.
dialogue.supper: A place setting is easier to read than a council notice. I wish the people we meant it for had been told.
dialogue.hearing: I'll deliver notices by hand. Some of those people have moved three times since the address in the book.
dialogue.date: I write dozens of addresses a day. Tonight I'd like to take the long way to yours.
dialogue.partner: Yes. Can I write to you even if I know I'll see you tomorrow? I've been saving a few things to say.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll press it between two letters I haven't sent.
dialogue.disliked_gift: I can't carry a fish on the route. Imagine what it would do to the bills.

routine.home_context: Starts the post route where Market Lane meets the new streets, with quick access to both.
